# Padelgree | The Confidential B2B Network for Padel Deals

> **Padelgree** (<https://padelgree.com> · English: <https://padelgree.com/en/>) is the confidential B2B network for padel deals. It orchestrates private, off-market introductions between padel club chains, independent club owners, commercial landlords, and institutional/private investors across Europe, the UK, and the USA. Zero public listings.

- **Spanish Home**: <https://padelgree.com/>
- **English Home**: <https://padelgree.com/en/>
- **Founder & Director**: Javier Villoria
- **Email**: <javier@padelgree.com>
- **Direct WhatsApp**: +34 680 31 74 86
- **Headquarters**: Madrid, Spain (Operating across ES, UK, IT, FR, DE, NL, SE, US).
